newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Xicor estimates lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Xicor estimates lowered.

text.p: Salomon Brothers analyst Erika Klauer said she lowered her estimates for Xicor Inc's fourth quarter 1996 and 1997 earnings, citing weaker fourth quarter orders resulting from a manufacturing problem.
But Klauer said she maintains a buy rating on the stock, saying the manufacturing problem was recently fixed.
She trimmed her fourth quarter estimate to $0.70 a share from $0.75 previously.
She lowered her 1997 estimate to $1.00 a share from $1.20 a share previously.
Xicor shares were down two to 8-1/8.
